integrity: Analytic proof; arithmetic script supplies illustrative independent computations but not infinite certification. No authorship or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The pointwise scalar component is studied only for the normalized convex disk class and parameters in [0,1]; no multidimensional extension failure is inferred. The residue pole is on the boundary; no interior pole is asserted.
title: Only endpoint parameters preserve Carathéodory positivity for all convex maps
